summary: Iteration 3 — focused frontend QA of the rebuilt ArchiveScene (isolated shot system) plus the requested regression sweep. Desktop 1920x800: swept the 800% pin at 29 depths (base=20960, y=base+d*8*innerHeight, Lenis immediate + 1.7s settle, hard reload before each run) with a clip-path-AWARE visibility probe (raw getBoundingClientRect alone gives false positives because .ax-mem is rendered at opacity 1 from load by the GSAP fromTo immediateRender, but its inset(4% 46%) band sits fully off-screen at x>=2106px). Results: (a) at NO depth are 3+ images actually visible — max is hero + traveler (d=0.2, bg2 op 0.26-0.35) or memory alone (d=0.55-0.65) or the tiny final alone (d>=0.82); (b) no glyph collisions between THE ARCHIVE / IS JUST / BEGINNING. (t2 and t3 bounding boxes overlap ~20px vertically at d=0.78-0.9 but leading-none glyph bodies are clear — verified in screenshots) and the meta line never touches them; (c) image frames are flush — hero img gap l/r = 0/0 at every depth with vertical headroom -43..+43px, memory img gap is negative (image overhangs) through the whole widest-clip window (d=0.58-0.62: l=-78/-44/-11, r=-56/-89/-123); the +40/+45px left gap that appears at d>=0.65 is fully hidden by the 46% inset band, so no background is ever revealed inside a frame; (d) reverse scrub 0.9 -> 0.25 fully restores the hero (op 0.90, visible, clip inset(11.9% 23.85%), scale-0.42 approach geometry) and THE ARCHIVE returns to its approach position (top=403) — no stuck opacity-0 elements; (e) exit wipe: .ax-dark reaches circle(106% ) at d=0.96 and circle(140%) at d=0.99 with the viewport 100% black in screenshots; the transit scene immediately after the pin travels horizontally (its two images move 1263->471->-453 px across d=0.15/0.45/0.8). Mobile 390x844 (hard reload): exactly one image at a time at every probed depth (0.1/0.25/0.4 hero, 0.5 headline only, 0.6 memory, 0.85 final), huge typography with no overlaps, horizontal overflow = 0, and ZERO leaks from void/transit/final/contact scenes into the archive viewport. Regression: VoidScene hands off into the ivory archive (bg rgb(234,230,223)) cleanly; FinalScene (KYMRSTUDIO letters) and ContactScene ('you made it to the last frame.' + email) render; nav-process/capabilities/contact anchors scroll (0->8480->13440->35279); nav-start fires exactly 1 ripple-overlay, navigates to /start and the overlay is torn down (0 nodes on arrival); /start estimator renders with volume slider/live estimate and the USD/INR toggle switches the investment line to rupees; pytest backend suite 9/9 pass. Console/page errors: ZERO across all runs. ONE REAL DEFECT FOUND: the FR.002 — SPEC CONCEPT chip on the memory frame is clipped out of existence by the shot-05 mask, so the brief's requirement of spec chips on hero+memory+final is only met for 2 of 3.

ui_bugs.issue: The FR.002 chip is positioned bottom-3 left-3 INSIDE .ax-mem, but every shot-05 clip-path removes that corner. Measured chip-visible fraction (clip-aware) desktop: d=0.58 clip inset(0.43% 17.46%) -> 0.00, d=0.60 clip inset(0% 14%) -> 0.12 (only a sliver of the 'F' renders, visible in the screenshot), d=0.61 -> 0.09, d=0.62 -> 0.00. Mobile is worse: clip inset(12.3% 0.04%) / inset(12.7% 0.08%) / inset(26.7% 1.7%) -> 0.00 at every depth, i.e. the memory chip is NEVER visible on mobile. Hero (FR.001, frac 1.0 at d=0.4) and final (FR.003, frac 1.0 at d=0.87) chips are fine. Fix: move the memory chip inside the guaranteed-safe band (e.g. desktop left >= 16% of frame width / vertically centred; mobile inset from top/bottom >= 14%), or render the chip as a sibling of .ax-mem that is animated with it instead of a clipped child.

critical_code_review_comments: GSAP fromTo() with default immediateRender applies the from-vars at timeline build time, which is why .ax-mem is opacity 1 and clip inset(4% 46%) from page load even though the markup says opacity-0. It happens to be off-screen (left 83vw + 46% inset > 100vw) so nothing leaks today, but any change to the memory frame's left/width could make it visible during shots 01-04. Prefer immediateRender:false or an explicit tl.set() at time 0.
Any chip/label placed inside an element that is animated with clip-path must live in the mask-safe area (or be a sibling) — the FR.002 defect above is exactly this class of bug.
Positive: hero now uses max-w-none, so the iteration-2 right-edge background reveal is gone (gap l=0 r=0 at all depths) and the memory image keeps negative gaps through its widest exposure.

rca_of_the_issue: FR.002 chip invisibility: .ax-mem is revealed exclusively through clip-path insets (desktop widest inset(0% 14%) = 156px removed from each side of a 1114px frame; mobile widest inset(12% 0%) = ~36px removed top and bottom of a 304px frame). The chip is absolutely positioned 12px from the frame's bottom-left corner, which lies inside the removed region at every keyframe, so the chip is masked away for the whole shot — the element is painted and in the DOM (hence it passes naive visibility assertions) but never rasterised on screen.
